wasm-callback-results:
    name: PHP-Wasm callback-result packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    env:
      LEAN_WASM_RUNTIME_PROFILE: browser
      LEAN_WASM_RUNTIME_VARIANT: php-wasm-3.1.68
      LEAN_WASM_ARTIFACT_TARGET: php-wasm-emscripten-3.1.68
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
      - name: Restore pinned PHP and compiler inputs
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            .toolchains
            build/php-wasm-sdk
            build/php-wasm-host
          key: consumer-php-callback-results-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('flake.lock', 'lean-toolchain', 'scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh', 'scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh', 'poc/lean-link-spike/bindings/php-wasm.package.json') }}
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Install PHP, compiler tools and log tooling
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential autoconf automake bison flex gperf libtool re2c cmake pkg-config php-cli php-dev php-common php-zip php-mbstring composer zstd ripgrep
          bash scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh --check-prerequisites
          if /usr/bin/php -r 'exit(extension_loaded("xdebug") ? 0 : 1);'; then
            sudo phpdismod -s cli xdebug
          fi
          env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /usr/bin/php -r 'if (extension_loaded("xdebug")) { fwrite(STDERR, "Consumer PHP must run without Xdebug.\n"); exit(1); }'
      - name: Build the pinned PHP-Wasm runtime and browser host
        run: |
          bash scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh
          export LEAN_WASM_EMSDK="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.toolchains/emsdk-php-wasm"
          bash scripts/build-lean-runtime.sh
          source scripts/env.sh
          node --input-type=module -e 'import {prepareOwnedPhpWasmRuntime} from "./tests/helpers/owned-php-wasm-runtime.mjs"; await prepareOwnedPhpWasmRuntime("build/php-wasm-callback-result-input");'
      - name: Verify callback-result owners and installed packages
        env:
          LEAN_BRIDGE_TEST_PHP_COPIED_RUNTIME: build/php-wasm-callback-result-input/php-wasm-runtime
        run: |
          source scripts/env.sh
          npm run test:owned-php-wasm-callback-results > build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results.log 2>&1
          cat build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results.log
          rg '^# tests 7$' build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results.log
          rg '^# pass 7$' build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results.log
          rg '^# fail 0$' build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results.log
          rg '^# cancelled 0$' build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results.log
          rg '^# skipped 0$' build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results.log
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results/no-host-packages.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results/host-packages.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results/combined-packages.json
          npm run test:owned-php-wasm-callback-evidence
      - name: Preserve PHP-Wasm callback-result acceptance
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: php-wasm-callback-results-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results/
            build/owned-php-wasm-callback-results.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  php-consumers:
    name: Native PHP and PHP-Wasm
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Installed acceptance plus the final cold mixed-profile Nix build exceeded
    # five hours. Keep every gate enabled and allow the runner's six-hour limit.
    timeout-minutes: 360
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
      - name: Restore pinned PHP and compiler inputs
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            .toolchains
            build/php-wasm-sdk
            build/php-wasm-host
          key: consumer-php-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('flake.lock', 'lean-toolchain', 'scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh', 'scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh', 'poc/lean-link-spike/bindings/php-wasm.package.json') }}
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Install native PHP and PHP-Wasm host build tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential autoconf automake bison flex gperf libtool re2c cmake pkg-config php-cli php-dev php-common php-zip php-mbstring composer zstd ripgrep
          bash scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh --check-prerequisites
      - name: Disable host PHP debugging instrumentation
        run: |
          if /usr/bin/php -r 'exit(extension_loaded("xdebug") ? 0 : 1);'; then
            sudo phpdismod -s cli xdebug
          fi
          env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /usr/bin/php -r 'if (extension_loaded("xdebug")) { fwrite(STDERR, "Consumer PHP must run without Xdebug.\n"); exit(1); }'
      - name: Build ordinary PHP packages and execute relocated Composer installations
        id: ordinary_php
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          LEAN_BRIDGE_NATIVE_PHP_TEST: "1"
        run: |
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --lean-only
          source scripts/env.sh
          node --test tests/php-brick-math.test.mjs tests/native-php.test.mjs
      - name: Compare weak and strict installed Composer callers with fresh Lean
        id: type_corpus_php_native
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP="$(command -v php)"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_COMPOSER="$(command -v composer)"
          source scripts/env.sh
          npm run test:type-corpus:php-native && LEAN_BRIDGE_REVIEWED_NATIVE_PROFILES=php-native node --test tests/type-corpus-reviewed-native.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_VALUES_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-copied-graph-values.test.mjs
          test -s build/recursive/php-values.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_CONVERSION_TEST=1 LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_NATIVE_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-copied-graph-conversions.test.mjs
          test -s build/recursive/php-conversions.json
          test -s build/recursive/php-native.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_PACKAGE_TEST=1 LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_INSTALLED_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-graph-package.test.mjs
          test -s build/recursive/php-package-cold.json
          test -s build/recursive/php-packages.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_REPRO_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-graph-package.test.mjs
          test -s build/recursive/php-reproducibility.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_LOADING_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-graph-package.test.mjs
          test -s build/recursive/php-composition.json
          test -s build/recursive/php-conflicts.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_CHAR_PROFILES=php-native node --test tests/native-char.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_WORD_PROFILES=php-native node --test tests/native-words.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_CALLABLE_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-callables.test.mjs tests/php-callable-contract.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_STRUCTURED_CALLABLE_TEST=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/php-structured-callables.test.mjs tests/php-structured-callable-contract.test.mjs
          test -s build/structured-callables/php-native.json
          npm run test:php-recursive-callables
          test -s build/recursive-callables/php-recursive.json
          test -s build/recursive-callables/php-mixed.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_COMPOUND_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-compounds.test.mjs tests/php-compound-contract.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_LIST_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-lists.test.mjs tests/php-list-contract.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_ALIAS_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-aliases.test.mjs tests/php-alias-contract.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_VARIANT_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-variants.test.mjs tests/php-variant-contract.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_CONVERSIONS_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-collection-conversions.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_EQUALITY_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-value-equality.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_COLLECTION_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-collections.test.mjs tests/php-collection-contract.test.mjs
          test -s build/collections/php-native-conversions.json
          test -s build/equality/php.json
          test -s build/collections/php-native.json
          test -s build/variants/php-native.json
          test -s build/aliases/php-native.json
          test -s build/lists/php-native.json
          test -s build/type-corpus/php-native.json
          test -s build/type-corpus/reviewed-native-php-native.json
      - name: Execute owned native PHP values and source-free Composer releases
        id: owned_php
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP="$(command -v php)"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_COMPOSER="$(command -v composer)"
          source scripts/env.sh
          LEAN_BRIDGE_OWNED_PHP_VALUES_TEST=1 node --test --test-name-pattern='^(?!.*32-bit PHP-Wasm)' tests/owned-php-values.test.mjs

          test -s build/owned-php-runtime/reviewed.json

          test -s build/owned-php-transfer-packaging/documentation.json
          test -s build/owned-php-borrows/ordinary.json

          test -s build/owned-php-borrow-packaging/ordinary.json

        continue-on-error: true

        run: |
          bash scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh
